tagline.id: Rig uji heat exchanger koil tembaga dengan katup servo dan control box.
tagline.en: A copper-coil heat exchanger test rig with a servo valve and control box.

approach.id: Heat exchanger koil tembaga dipasang bersama reaktor dummy dan bak, dengan aliran diatur katup servo. Kontrolnya memakai control box V3 dengan casing PCB custom.
approach.en: A copper-coil heat exchanger is set up with a dummy reactor and buckets, with flow set by a servo valve. Control runs on the V3 control box with a custom PCB casing.
